programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Chingari
programme.desc: A prostitute leads a glum life but finds happiness and hope when she falls in love with a postman. However, things take a turn when a priest, who disapproves of the alliance, gets him killed.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Star
programme.desc: Dev, an ambitious singer, wishes to become a star like Elvis Presley. But, his middle-class life compels him to give up on his dreams, until he finds a job with Charlie's Disco which changes his life.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Taekwondo Inspires Changes in Kids
programme.desc: A Brazilian couple who moved to Shiga Prefecture in Japan teach taekwondo to children - their efforts are helping kids develop more than just athletically.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: Australia's 'worst-ever' wildfires in 2019 had a devastating impact on endangered species including koalas - we examine the cause of these fires and explore ways to minimise future catastrophes.

programme.title: Clothes That Transcend Time
programme.desc: Akita / Koike Kazuko (Creative Director): The Nishimonai Bon Odori Festival has been held for over 700 years - Koike finds timeless beauty in its costumes remade using beloved family kimonos.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet two men in Shimane - Korean Sanghyun uses local rice in Unnan City to brew makgeolli as it's done in his homeland, and Nepalese Nandeshwar tends the front desk of an inn in Tamatsukuri Onsen.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Kaizoku
programme.desc: The Murakami Kaizoku were seafarers and fighters in the Seto Inland Sea - we explore their history and legacy with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: the Seto Inland Sea.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: We look at how Sendai has transformed into a disaster-resilient city with its 'multiple defences', countermeasures taken in its coastal area to minimise damage from a tsunami.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to eyes. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #11 Do you have any lucky charms? / If you want to ask if a shop has a certain item, say the item's name and 'wa arimasu ka'.

programme.title: Captivated by Washi Paper
programme.desc: A Dutchman makes traditional washi paper, growing the raw materials and even creating artworks with it - his mission is to add new value to washi and forge a path forward into the future.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: In a special feature on Hokkaido, programmes looked at the ecology of brown bears, a special bento lunch, and a bountiful landscape formed by rugged natural conditions and pioneering development.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Wild Hokkaido!
programme.desc: Two cycling guides ride on snowy roads toward a mountain lake - passing by railroad remnants, they reach the frozen-over and snow-covered Lake Nukabira where cycling on the ice is permitted in winter.

programme.title: The Masterpieces of Tsutaju
programme.desc: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period - this episode takes a close look at artist Utamaro's iconic 'Woman with a Glass Noisemaker'.

programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.desc: Reading: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Reading, the 6-0 hammering of West Ham at the Madejski Stadium in 2007.

programme.title: PDC Classics 2023
programme.desc: Overcoming the nerves of a TV debut, Canadian youngster Dawson Murschell announced himself to the world during this classic contest against James Wade in 2017. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: PDC Classics 2023
programme.desc: In a classic at the World Matchplay in July 2011, Simon Whitlock let a seemingly unassailable lead slip when Andy Hamilton recovered from a 15-8 deficit. Contains flashing images.

programme.title: PL Darts: Glasgow

programme.title: Darts Gold: Van Gerwen v Lewis

programme.title: Darts Gold: Barneveld v Bunting
programme.desc: A chance to relive some classic darts matches. Here Raymond van Barneveld faces Stephen Bunting in the quarter-finals of the 2015 World Darts Championship.

programme.title: Darts Gold: Van Gerwen v Barneveld
programme.desc: A look back at some classic darts action. Here, Dutch pair Michael van Gerwen and Raymond van Barneveld meet in round three of the 2016 World Darts Championship at the Alexandra Palace.

programme.title: PGA Tour Golf Highlights
programme.desc: The final day of the AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am, a PGA Tour event staged in California. Rory McIlroy finished two clear of Shane Lowry to claim victory a year ago. (15.02)

programme.title: PGA Tour Golf Highlights
programme.desc: The concluding day of the PGA Tour's Genesis Invitational at the Riviera Country Club. Last year, Ryder Cup star Ludvig Åberg claimed victory. (22.02)

programme.title: PGA Tour Champions Highlights
programme.desc: Tournament highlights from the Chubb Classic - a PGA Tour Champions event held at Tiburon Golf Club in Naples, Florida. The 1997 Open winner Justin Leonard won this event last year.

programme.desc: Two men dress as women in order to rent a room, but there's trouble when they fall in love with their landlord's two daughters.

programme.title: Aandhi
programme.desc: Story of a young woman who aspires to become a politician but falls in love with an ordinary man. This is a story about their lives' trials and tribulations.

programme.title: Justice Choudhary

programme.title: Duniya
programme.desc: An advocate faces heavy odds defending the brother of his sweetheart.

programme.desc: An innocent man is embroiled in underworld after being falsely charged and sets out to punish the perpetrators who subjected his life to misery.

programme.title: Ramji Londonwale

programme.title: Amne Samne

programme.title: Bairaag
